SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.points AS points, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS solveCount FROM questions q LEFT JOIN submissions s ON q.id = s.question_id WHERE q.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY q.id, q.points
